clips.title: The story
paras: At the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, Therylune waits for a chance to escape her captors. Twilight's Hammer cultists have trapped the dryad at the ancient site, and she needs a traveler's help to reach safety.

Therylune is a dryad, a daughter of Cenarius who guards nature. She came from the tranquil woodlands of northern Kalimdor to the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. Twilight's Hammer cultists have gathered at the ancient excavation and ambushed her. Surrounded by their swarms, she cannot fight her way free alone. She needs an escort through the cultists and out to safety.
